# Picsel

> Picsel builds websites for tradespeople anywhere in the UK, gets them found on Google and in AI search, and keeps them there.

Contact: Ben Miller, 07456 809049, ben@picsel.co.uk
Area served: United Kingdom

Picsel is a new studio. It has built 5 live sites, all listed below, and
makes no claims about client numbers, years in business or awards, because it has
none to make. Anything stated here can be checked against the live sites.

## What the studio does

- Websites for tradespeople and small businesses, anywhere in the UK
- Search work, both Google and AI assistants
- Google Business Profile setup and upkeep
- Custom automation tools for repetitive office work
- One trade per patch on our Growth plan

## What it costs

- Online: £99 to build, then £15 a month. A smart, professional website built for your trade, live within a week. Set and forget: it just works.
- Managed: £149 to build, then £29 a month. Everything in Online, looked after, so you never have to touch it.
- Growth: £149 to build, then £119 a month. Everything in Managed, plus active work every month to put you in front of people who are searching right now.

Full prices, including what each plan does not cover, are at https://picsel.co.uk/prices/.

- [Websites for tradesmen, from £15 a month | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/): We build fast, honest websites for tradespeople anywhere in the UK, get you found on Google and in AI search, and keep you there. From £15 a month.

- [A Nevitt Construction | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/nevitt-construction/): A site for a family-run building contractor in Hayle, covering everything from single-storey extensions to full design-and-build new homes.
- [Julie Miller Art | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/julie-miller-art/): A portfolio for an illustrator working in mixed media in the Scottish Borders, where the landscape drives the work. Built by Picsel.
- [Lanora House | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/lanora-house/): A licensed house clearance and cleaning firm working across Cornwall and the South West. Built by Picsel.
- [AJC Removals & Clearances | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/ajc-removals/): A removals and clearance company covering Cornwall, Devon and beyond. Built by Picsel.
- [House of Cornwall | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/work/house-of-cornwall/): Live clearance auctions broadcast from Hayle every week, selling antiques, retro pieces and curiosities that come out of real house clearances.
- [Website prices for tradespeople | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/prices/): Three plans, from £15 a month with a £99 build fee. What each one covers, what it does not, and the add-ons. No retainer, no lock-in.
- [Guides for tradespeople | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/): Plain answers to the questions tradespeople ask about websites, Google Business Profiles, reviews and what any of it should cost. No sales pitch.
- [What a tradesman's website needs | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/what-a-trades-website-needs/): Your phone number on every page, the jobs you do in the words customers use, the towns you cover, photos of your own work and a few reviews.
- [Why your Google Business Profile is not showing](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/google-business-profile-not-showing/): Usually one of four things: it is not verified, the category is wrong, your details do not match, or an old duplicate is competing with it.
- [How much a tradesman's website should cost](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/how-much-a-trades-website-costs/): About £500 to £2,000 as a one off, or £15 to £120 a month on a subscription. What each price actually buys, and what to ask before you pay.
- [What GEO is, and why it matters for trades](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/what-is-geo/): GEO is getting your business quoted by AI assistants when someone asks one to recommend a tradesperson. Why it matters, and what actually helps.
- [How to get more Google reviews | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/guides/how-to-get-more-google-reviews/): Ask every customer in person on the day the job finishes, and hand them a short link. What stops it working, and two things that get you penalised.
- [Blog: websites for tradespeople | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/blog/): What this studio thinks about websites for tradespeople, what they cost and why they cost it. Opinions rather than answers. The answers are in the guides.
- [Why trades websites cost so much | Picsel](https://picsel.co.uk/blog/why-trades-websites-cost-so-much/): Where the money goes in a three thousand pound website quote, what a trades site actually has to do, and what a straight-priced alternative looks like.
- [Contact Picsel: websites for tradespeople](https://picsel.co.uk/contact/): Ring Picsel on 07456 809049, email ben@picsel.co.uk, or send an enquiry. Websites and Google visibility for tradespeople anywhere in the UK.
